headline: RBA lifts cash rate 25bp to 4.85%, as expected, in a split 6-3 vote; sees inflation above 3% for the coming year
why: The hike was fully expected (about 80-90% priced). The 6-3 split and dropped tightening bias read slightly dovish, so the Aussie dollar slipped about 0.3% instead of rallying.
india: Little direct effect on India. The rupee and Indian stocks are unlikely to react; Australian rate moves matter mainly for AUD/INR remittances and education payments.
watch_next: Governor Bullock's comments and the next RBA meeting: some banks see one more hike by February 2027, others say rates have peaked.

impact.why: Hike was priced in and the split vote hints at a peak, so AUD dipped about 0.3%.
